How much does it cost to run an electric pizza oven?

A typical electric pizza oven uses about 1,700 watts (1,200–2,200W depending on the model). Used for 30 minutes per use, 1 use a week, it costs about 18p per use and £9.31 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per use
18p
About £9.31 a year at 30 minutes per use, 1 use a week.

Standing charge not included.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Use the smallest appliance that does the job: a microwave or air fryer usually beats the oven for small portions.
  • Turn things off at the wall if they sit on standby all day.
  • Check the energy label when you replace an appliance; running costs over its life often outweigh the price difference.

Questions

How much does it cost to run an electric pizza oven per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 1700W model costs about 36p an hour, allowing for it running at full power about 80% of the time.

How much does it cost to run an electric pizza oven per year?

About £9.31 a year, based on 30 minutes per use, 1 use a week. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my electric pizza oven's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
